description.text: Fling crackling balls of electrical energy that explode on contact with enemies or blocks. to trigger multiple smaller balls directly in front of you. Primary Fire Damage - 10 World Damage - 10 Splash Damage - 20 Splash World Damage - 20 Splash Radius - 3 Attack time - 0.8 Max Range - 60 Secondary Fire Splash Damage - 12 Splash World Damage - 12 Splash Radius - 2 Attack time - 0.5 Max Range - 3.5 Magazine - 5 Reload - 4s

ru.original: Fling crackling balls of electrical energy that explode on contact with enemies or blocks. <BINDING_CAST2> to trigger multiple smaller balls directly in front of you.
ru.translation: Запускай во врагов электрические шары, которые взрываются при попадании в цель. Нажми <BINDING_CAST2>, чтобы создать щит из таких шаров перед собой.

es.original: Fling crackling balls of electrical energy that explode on contact with enemies or blocks. <BINDING_CAST2> to trigger multiple smaller balls directly in front of you.
es.translation: <BINDING_CAST1> para lanzar una bola de energía eléctrica que explota al tocar enemigos o bloques. <BINDING_CAST2> para lanzar varias bolas pequeñas.

de.original: Fling crackling balls of electrical energy that explode on contact with enemies or blocks. <BINDING_CAST2> to trigger multiple smaller balls directly in front of you.
de.translation: Schmeiß mit knisternden Bällen elektrischer Energie um dich, die bei Kontakt mit Gegnern oder deren Blöcken explodieren. Die <BINDING_CAST2> löst mehrere kleinere Bälle vor Vander aus.

pt.original: Fling crackling balls of electrical energy that explode on contact with enemies or blocks. <BINDING_CAST2> to trigger multiple smaller balls directly in front of you.
pt.translation: Arremesse esferas de energia elétrica que explodem ao atingir inimigos ou blocos. Aperte <BINDING_CAST2> para disparar múltiplas esferas menores diretamente à sua frente.

fr.original: Fling crackling balls of electrical energy that explode on contact with enemies or blocks. <BINDING_CAST2> to trigger multiple smaller balls directly in front of you.
fr.translation: Décochez des boules de foudre crépitantes qui exploseront au contact d'ennemis ou de blocs. L'action secondaire (<BINDING_CAST2>) permet d'envoyer plusieurs décharges plus petites droit devant vous.

description.text: Fling crackling balls of electrical energy that explode on contact with enemies or blocks. to trigger multiple smaller balls directly in front of you. Primary Fire Damage - 10 World Damage - 10 Splash Damage - 20 Splash World Damage - 20 Splash Radius - 3 Attack time - 0.8 Max Range - 60 Secondary Fire Splash Damage - 12 Splash World Damage - 12 Splash Radius - 2 Attack time - 0.5 Max Range - 3.5 Magazine - 5 Reload - 4s Secondary fire uses 1-5 loaded ammo: one lightning ball per ammo spent, up to five. Each ball deals 12 splash damage (2 ammo: 24 total; 5 ammo: 60 total).
